findings.title: Existing membership PATCH requests now silently hide the group
findings.body: The resource still exposes PATCH /admin/groups/:id, but update no longer handles the previously supported changes: {add: ..., delete: ...} payload. An existing client sending that payload now receives success without changing membership, and because it does not supply visible, this assignment also sets the group's visibility to false. Preserve the PATCH behavior or explicitly reject the obsolete payload instead of silently applying an unrelated settings change.

findings.title: Public member lists are truncated without pagination controls
findings.body: findMembers now requests only 50 members by default, and the server applies that limit to every group. The public group members template has no pagination controls or load-more mechanism, and this route makes only one request. Consequently, users cannot view members beyond the first 50; custom groups previously returned their complete member list. Add pagination to the public page or otherwise fetch the remaining members.

findings.title: Exact page-size multiples produce an extra empty page
findings.body: The total-page calculation uses floor(user_count / limit) + 1, which overcounts whenever the member count is an exact multiple of the page size. For example, a group with 50 members and a limit of 50 shows two pages and enables Next, which requests offset 50 and displays an empty member list. Use a ceiling-based calculation so the last populated page disables Next.
